d:
Kya bihar men sharabbandi ne apna maqsad pura kiya ya ye qanun sirf ek adhura vada sabit huaa? inhin savalon ke javab talashne ki koshish ki bibisi sanvaddata raghvendr rav aur vidiyo jarnalist seraj ali ne. dekhie bihar se unki ye khas graund riport.
Sahyog vibhas jha, sthaniy patrakar
• bibisi hindi se aap in soshal midiya chainals par bhi jur sakte hain-
